title: Deleting a Root Certificate for Zero Trust Browser in Private Access

blocks.text: Almost all root certificates can be deleted, excluding the default Zscaler Root Certificate. This is because at least one root certificate is required per isolation profile. To learn more, see About Root Certificates for Zero Trust Browser in Private Access.

Additionally, if any other custom root certificates are associated with an isolation profile, you cannot delete them. You must first disable a certificate from the isolation profile before deleting it. To learn more, see Editing an Isolation Profile for Private Access.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Browser Isolation Private Apps > Root Certificates.
Click the Delete icon for the certificate. If the certificate is the default or is associated with an isolation profile, the delete icon is not available.
The Confirm: Delete Certificate window appears.
